picks.thesis: Bear call spread on QQQ with short call delta 0.3107 offers the highest credit‑to‑width (0.32) among the list. With 1 DTE and IV 0.1794 you can capture rapid time decay before the week’s events while the delta sits near the middle of the typical band.
Bull put spread on QQQ with short put delta ‑0.3116 provides a strong credit‑to‑width of 0.29, 1 DTE and IV 0.2049, giving ample premium and a mid‑range delta to balance risk ahead of the event.
